source.title: EMP and UMAX Container Specifications
source.reads: Read twice: page text via curl + HTML-to-text (table rows label | value), and a separate fetch asking for every table row character for character; both gave the same figures.
source.note: EMP and UMAX are the rail-owned 53' domestic container fleets Union Pacific gives shippers access to. One specification is published for the fleet; the page says to contact a Union Pacific Market Analyst with specification questions.

containers.name: 53' domestic container, Union Pacific EMP / UMAX
